result: Audited existing phase3-final material before accepting it. Found missing self-test dependency, response-buffering regression, insufficient shared normalization for double-encoded edge attacks, and a Phase 2 test-wiring defect.
Created phase3-independent-final from independently verified phase2-independent-verified so Phase 2 hardening remained the base.
Implemented http-v2 with 40 bounded numeric features, NFKC normalization, path/query-safe multi-pass decoding, bounded query/header/body processing and security indicators.
Wired EdgeWAF to http-v2 and made edge rules consume the same normalization semantics.
Repaired Phase 2 oversized-response test wiring and advanced stale Phase 2 configuration expectations to phase3/http-v2.
36/36 tests passed; compileall passed; 20,000 fuzz inputs completed with 0 extraction exceptions; Nginx integration passed; secret and stub scans passed; complete Phase 3 self-test passed.

Final direct feature benchmark: 100,000 extractions at 18,569.43 req/s. Final direct E2E benchmark: 5,000 requests at concurrency 100, 4,500 allow, 500 block, 4,500 upstream hits, 1,625.32 req/s, 1,000 retained events. Complete self-test measured 14,023.29 feature extractions/s and 1,555.51 E2E req/s under its execution window.
Saved durable Phase 3 state, feature manifest, audit, journal, future-chat context and requirements matrix.
Phase 3 PASS at the required 100 percent milestone gate. Overall Challenge 3 remains IN_PROGRESS.
